fields.description: Venera is a three- and four-bedroom townhouse neighbourhood in The Valley’s second phase. Emaar combines contemporary facades, large windows and garden-facing living spaces with paths and outdoor recreation. The gated setting is planned around landscaped common areas, with seven named townhouse styles in its own floor-plan collection.

overview: Venera’s cluster plan distributes play spaces, flexible lawns and sports facilities through the neighbourhood. The wider phase-two landscape adds trails and outdoor gathering areas. These shared facilities belong to the development plan; their delivery and access should be confirmed for the selected home.
research.locationNote: Venera lies in the southern part of the published Valley phase-two plan. The Valley is on the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor. Emaar also describes wider Jebel Ali–Lahbab connectivity; this does not establish a direct junction, metro station or fixed commute for an individual townhouse.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s Venera page displays AED 2.48m. Property Finder records approximately AED 2.5m for three bedrooms and AED 2.8m for four as developer references. These starting figures do not confirm currently available stock or the asking price of a resale home.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan consists of 10% on booking, seven further 10% stages and 20% at completion. Four interim stages carry construction conditions. The dates are historical contractual milestones, not a live progress report.
research.handoverNote: September 2028 is the completion estimate in the Emaar-branded payment document and Property Finder timeline. Confirm the current date and conditions in the selected home’s contract.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Table figures are published totals including suite, garage and balcony/terrace areas; they are not plot sizes.

facts.label: Home arrangement
facts.value: Plans show two levels, enclosed kitchens, maid’s accommodation and covered parking. Four-bedroom examples include a downstairs guest bedroom.

unresolved: The linked brochure also covers Velora. Its commercial table is shown beside a Velora plan, so those plot averages are not treated as a confirmed Venera unit schedule.
The payment document and location map are Emaar-branded broker-hosted copies. Obtain current developer-issued documents and the individual plot plan.
